en: Colorized view of a grand Baroque palace complex with richly decorated façades and a prominent entrance pavilion topped by a large greenish dome-crown with a golden crown ornament. A wooden bridge crosses a water-filled moat or canal in front of the building, and a flower garden with red blossoms occupies the foreground. The image has the typical printed look and proportions of a vintage tourism postcard. No visible printed text appears on the front.
